name: DAT Outgo
pricing: 3% under $18K of monthly invoicing, 2.5% from $18K to $80K, custom above $80K
summary: Load-board owner DAT runs this non-recourse factoring program with a published rate table by monthly invoice volume.
differentiator: One of only two factors we read that publishes a full rate and transfer-fee table. The rate drops from 3% to 2.5% at $18K of monthly invoicing, so a carrier just under that line pays $540 a month on $18K at 3% versus $450 at 2.5% just above it. ACH is free, a wire is $20, and instant pay costs 1% capped at $20.

terms.rate: Owner-operator: less than $18k monthly invoicing 3%; $18k-$80k 2.5%; $80k+ custom
terms.recourse: Non-recourse: "Your business is protected if a broker goes bankrupt"
terms.contract: No annual contracts and no cancellation fees
terms.minimum: No reserve and no minimum fees
terms.transfers: ACH (1-3 days) free; wire (same or next day) $20.00; instant 1.0% fee, max $20.00
terms.otherFees: If you choose not to factor, at Day 30 your rate drops to 1.0%
terms.fuel: Outgo Card: 1.0% factoring rate on purchases

costModel.note: ACH transfers, which are free. Wires add $20 each. Above $80K a month the rate is custom.

bestFor: Owner-operators already on the DAT load board who want a rate they can check before applying.
skipIf: You haul mostly for brokers DAT will not buy invoices from; ask first.
